title: Pet Pals theme brings playful touch to vivo V80 with OriginOS 7
summary: What if your phone had a little companion waiting to greet you every time you unlocked the screen? With the upcoming vivo V80, powered by OriginOS 7, users can add a playful touch to their screens…

blocks.text: What if your phone had a little companion waiting to greet you every time you unlocked the screen? With the upcoming vivo V80, powered by OriginOS 7, users can add a playful touch to their screens with Pet Pals, a wallpaper theme featuring virtual pets that move and interact with users.

More than just static wallpaper, Pet Pals brings a little character to the lock screen, turning everyday moments like checking notifications or glancing at the time into something more delightful. For pet lovers, it is a charming way to add a touch of cuteness to a device they reach for throughout the day.
More ways to personalize the vivo V80
Pet Pals is just one of the ways OriginOS 7 makes personalization more fun.

The vivo V80 also features Wiggle, which brings movement to wallpaper through motion-responsive effects; Glint, which adds shimmering visual details; and StickIt, which lets users decorate their system with playful stickers.
From adorable companions to eye-catching effects, these themes make the vivo V80 experience feel more personal, turning everyday phone interactions into opportunities for self-expression.
With Pet Pals and the other OriginOS 7 themes, the vivo V80 brings personality to these everyday interactions, showing how even a simple screen unlock can become an opportunity for self-expression.

Curious to see these playful features in action? Discover Pet Pals and more of the vivo V80 experience by tuning in to the vivo V80 launch livestream on vivo Philippines’ official Facebook page on October 30 at 6 PM
